sources.title: Al-Shajarah, About the Journal (International Islamic University Malaysia)
sources.note: Official about page read. It states a remit in Islamic thought and civilisation, science, Malay world studies, and related theology, history, art, architecture and heritage. The classification uses the central stated remit, not every occasional subject.

sources.title: Afriques (OpenEdition), history keyword and issue index
sources.note: Journal-hosted keyword and issue index read. The index lists historical and archaeological issues across African regions and periods; it supports an Africa classification but is not a full publisher-remit statement.
